item.description:
The big 1.0 — three new modules, on-device OCR, and signed auto-updates.

New modules

  • Clipboard — manual stash for text, images, and files. Press ⌃⌥V or drag onto the notch. Rich text preserved. On-device OCR via Vision makes screenshot text searchable. Pin entries, edit them as snippets, full keyboard nav, Quick Look any row with space. Concealed-clipboard hints from password managers are honored.
  • Notes — daily notepad with auto-rollover. Today is editable; at midnight it slides into a scrollable archive that renders markdown.
  • Stopwatch — new mode in the Timer module, drift-free pause and resume.

Auto-updates

From this release on, Ledge updates itself with a clean prompt — no more manual DMG re-downloads. Updates are signed with an EdDSA key; the app refuses anything unsigned. The only network call for updates is the appcast at satsdisco.github.io/ledge.

Polish

  • Timer / stopwatch layout balanced vertically in the panel
  • File Shelf expanded view layout matches other modules
  • Settings → Shortcuts now lists every Clipboard-panel keystroke plus tips
